rule: AI-prepared columns are proposed_* / proposal_origin / finding_group / page_image. Only a person fills human_*. Blank or unresolved_* is unresolved truth: never an AI success, never a confirmed error.
ambiguity: Reserved for an unresolved fact or association. Two legible identifiers with clear roles are settled, not ambiguous.

columns.scope: why the item is in the packet (as v1)
columns.doc: path relative to the staged project folders
columns.page_image: relative link to the v1 packet page image, or 'open the original'
columns.proposed_identity_rows: number of rows for this item in IDENTITIES-v2.csv
columns.human_identity_status: settled | unresolved_fact | unresolved_association | absent | illegible | conflict
columns.human_own_identity_for_evaluation: the literal marked yes in IDENTITIES-v2.csv, or blank
columns.human_uncertainty: short reason whenever a status is not settled

columns.proposed_role: AI-prepared: own_document | permit | reviewed_document | referenced_document | unclassified
columns.proposal_note: the label author's free-form note (source, confidence, a cut cell), kept whole; never a printed label
columns.proposal_origin: the label set or Review 07 finding the proposal came from
columns.human_role: own_document | own_document_alternate | permit | request | reviewed_document | transmitted_item | listed_item | referenced_document | project_or_contract | other
columns.human_own_for_evaluation: yes | no | unresolved (exactly one yes per settled item)

columns.human_quantity: exact literal with decimal point, sign or unit
columns.human_uncertainty: short reason whenever a status is not settled

evaluation_use: Labels v3 take the settled rows. The register is evaluated on the identity marked yes; the other settled identities keep their roles, so a reading of one of them is scored as a correct reading with that role, not as a wrong own identity. Unresolved fields leave the denominators and are reported as coverage gaps.
